title: Maternal exposure to traffic-related air pollution and birth defects in Massachusetts.
authors: Girguis MS, Strickland MJ, Hu X, Liu Y, Bartell SM, Vieira VM.
quote: There were positive but non-significant associations for a 10µg/m(3) increase in PM2.5 and perimembranous ventricular septal defects (OR=1.34, 95% CI: 0.98, 1.83), patent foramen ovale (OR=1.19, 95% CI: 0.92, 1.54) and patent ductus arteriosus (OR=1.20, 95% CI: 0.95, 1.62).
